target.statement: VIF of k-means color quantization of the statlab image in RGB colorspace with k=8 is 0.500

compute.basis: The target requires implementing k-means (with k-means++ initialization and Hartigan-Wong updates) on a small image (486×1155 pixels) and computing VIF; no code is provided, but the image is publicly available and the computation is lightweight on a CPU.

blockers: No code or data links provided in the paper; must implement k-means and VIF from scratch.
The statlab image is not directly linked; it is described as a photograph of a plaque at Iowa State University, and may need to be sourced from the web or recreated.
title: Optimized $k$-means color quantization of digital images in machine-based and human perception-based colorspaces
